name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Computer Pilot mode, 30° dive from 8,000 ft, pickle before 4,500 ft
procedure: A/G, delivery mode COMPUTER PILOT (CCIP), station and quantity set
Roll in, pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle by release altitude, no lower — 4 G recovery

name: 45° Dive CCIP
summary: Steep dive from 12,000 ft, pickle before 6,500 ft
procedure: Steep roll-in — the Tomcat builds speed fast, throttle back
Pickle by release altitude, no lower — 5 G recovery, do not press

name: Pop-up 20°
summary: 500 ft run-in, pop to a 30° climb, pull down onto a 20° dive, release by 3,500 ft
procedure: A/G, COMPUTER PILOT set before the IP
At the pop: pull, MAX power, check the apex altitude
Roll in, pipper on, pickle by release altitude, no lower

name: Level CCRP 18k (LGB)
summary: Straight and level, RIO lases with LANTIRN, computer release
procedure: A/G, COMPUTER TARGET (CCRP); RIO designates the target in the LANTIRN pod, laser code set
Wings level, pickle and hold — release at the cue
RIO lases from 8–10 s before impact until impact

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low, computer release of high-drag bombs
procedure: A/G, COMPUTER TARGET with the target designated
Level at 500 ft, pickle and hold through release
